name: portfolio_policy-hold-vs-redeploy
notes: ADR-0279 Stages 1-4 on aggregate positions: the latest schwab_positions snapshot -> liquidation tax per holding; market blocks -> beta hold returns; an onboarded backtest series -> deflated active hurdle; hold vs redeploy decision -> rows written. Every rate, horizon, premium and field name is a value of THIS document; the kinds carry none. The as_of, rates and returns below are placeholders the owner sets before the first real run; they are the experiment's identity, so changing them changes the hash on purpose.

positions.notes: Role 'data': the deduplicated positions snapshot acquired through dskit.onboarding (connector schwab_positions). One row per account x symbol x day; latest acquisition wins.

tax.notes: Aggregate rows carry no acquisition date, so every holding takes default_holding until a lot-level source adds an 'acquired' field (then declare acquired_field). Rates are the owner's marginal federal + NIIT placeholders; state tax is not included.

market.notes: Role 'data': the market's expected nominal return from four public numbers (research A0001): S&P 500 dividend yield, long-run real earnings growth, expected inflation, and the drift from today's Shiller CAPE toward a fair CAPE over reversion_years. Placeholders; the owner refreshes them from public data before each real run.

betas.notes: risk_free + beta x (market - risk_free) per symbol. betas is the owner's table (a 5-year monthly beta from any public source); a holding missing from it refuses, on purpose: no default_beta here, so a new position cannot be silently priced as the market.

active_returns.notes: Role 'data': the per-period NET returns of the active strategy the cash would go to, onboarded from a child's scored backtest (one jsonl row per period: period, net_return) through localfiles. Data enters through onboarding, so the series the hurdle is built on is a WORM snapshot with a digest, not a pasted number.

hurdle.notes: Stage 3: (mean - E[max null Sharpe] x sd) x periods, the return left once what selection alone would have found is removed. trials is the owner's honest count of strategy variants tried; min_dsr is the pre-registered admissibility bar — below it the hurdle is withheld and every holding holds.

decide.notes: Both returns come wired: hold from $betas.rates, redeploy from $hurdle.rate (None when inadmissible -> hold). No return literal exists in this node. risk_premium is 0 because the hurdle is already deflated; raise it only for a cost the hurdle cannot see. terminal_tax_rate liquidates BOTH paths at the horizon at the long-term rate (hold over the original basis, redeploy over its after-tax start), so the comparison is net to net.

params.source: hold-vs-redeploy decisions per account x symbol

decisions.notes: Role 'report': the advisory rows, one per holding, with liq_* and the decision, in ./decisions under the invoking cwd, one file per run so no run shadows another (ADR-0247). Never an order.

outputs.notes: Empty = ./pipeline_runs under the invoking cwd. Placement is not identity.
